value.name: select appraiser from list
value.description: The group considers three appraiser candidates and chooses the second name on the list, Beverly Ostrowski.
evidence: Lucia objected on principle; Rosa, asked her opinion, said she had no opinion about appraisers but that she trusted the counselor to know who was honest, and the counselor said any of the three names was honest, and they took the second name on the list, which was a woman named Beverly Ostrowski

value.name: confirm appraiser's reputation
value.description: Rosa recalls neighborhood gossip that Beverly Ostrowski had fairly appraised the house across the street the previous spring.
evidence: who had appraised the house across the street the previous spring and was, by Rosa's recollection of neighborhood gossip, fair

value.name: finish morning formalities
value.description: By eleven, the formal work of the morning is completed and Asha closes her folder without leaving yet.
evidence: By eleven they were done with the formal work of the morning. Asha closed her folder. She did not yet stand up.

value.name: Asha announces final request
value.description: Asha says she has one more non-legal request to make before leaving them to their morning.
evidence: "There is one more thing," she said, "that I would like to say, and then I will leave you to your morning. It is not legal advice. It is a request."

value.name: family listens to Asha
value.description: The three family members turn their attention to Asha as she begins speaking.
evidence: The three of them looked at her.

value.name: Asha frames co-ownership tension
value.description: Asha explains that the siblings are now co-owners of a building and also the three people who loved their mother most closely, and warns that those roles will conflict.
evidence: "You are now," she said, "the co-owners of a building. You are also, separately and not by my doing and not by anything that will appear in the file, the three people who loved your mother most closely in the last decade of her life. Those two facts are going to be in tension over the next two weeks."

value.name: Asha defines legal frame as temporary
value.description: Asha says the legal structure is meant only to keep the family tension productive and cannot resolve it.
evidence: "The legal frame I have given you is designed to keep that tension productive. It is not designed to resolve it. It cannot resolve it."

value.name: Asha predicts private resolution
value.description: Asha tells them any real resolution will happen in the room without her and possibly without documents.
evidence: "The resolution will happen, if it happens, in this room, without me, and possibly without any document at all."

value.name: Asha asks for personal commitment
value.description: Asha begins asking each of them, as someone who has seen families handle this well and badly, to do something specific for one another.
